navbar.label: Navbar
navbar.description: Sticky top bar with brand, up to 6 links, and an optional call-to-action button. Must be first.

hero.label: Hero
hero.description: Opening statement: headline, supporting line, one or two buttons. size md|lg|xl controls the headline scale; layout 'split' adds a decorative product panel beside the copy.

features.label: Feature grid
features.description: Titled grid of 1-8 features, each with an icon, a short title, and a sentence of body text.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: Grid of 1-9 cards for projects, articles, or products. Give an item a `stat` (e.g. '12.4k') to turn it into a metric tile - this is how dashboards are built. `meta` is a small label such as a category or delta.

items.title: Harbour Lights
items.body: A month on the Baltic coast.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.description: Full-width band of 1-6 short customer quotes with name and role. Avatars are initials (no images).

items.quote: It replaced three tools for us.
items.name: Ada Lovelace

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.description: 1-4 pricing tiers with price, feature list, and a button. Set highlighted=true on the recommended tier.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: Expandable question-and-answer list of 1-10 items (native <details>, no JavaScript).

cta.label: CTA
cta.description: Closing call-to-action panel: headline, optional line of support, one button.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: Closing footer with brand, tagline, up to 4 link columns (link labels only), and a copyright line. Must be last.
